findings.summary: zip: Critical Parser Differential & Security Control Bypass via Dual-Header Inconsistencies (Zip Cloaking) Leading to Arbitrary File Overwrite & RCE
ZipStreamReader::extract() and ZipArchive::extract() apply Unix permissions through symlinks without confining the target

evidence: the project's source does not use ZipStreamReader::extract, ZipArchive::extract, but other packages depend on zip

findings.summary: zip: Critical Parser Differential & Security Control Bypass via Dual-Header Inconsistencies (Zip Cloaking) Leading to Arbitrary File Overwrite & RCE
Diesel's SQLite backend has possible UTF-8 corruption
lz4_flex's decompression can leak information from uninitialized memory or reused output buffer
Mio's tokens for named pipes may be delivered after deregistration
oneshot has potential Use After Free when used asynchronously
rust-openssl has incorrect bounds assertion in aes key wrap
rust-openssl: rustMdCtxRef::digest_final() writes past caller buffer with no length check
rust-openssl: Unchecked callback length in PSK/cookie trampolines leaks adjacent memory to peer
rust-openssl: Deriver::derive and PkeyCtxRef::derive can overflow short buffers on OpenSSL 1.1.1

evidence: the project's source does not use Deriver::derive, PkeyCtxRef::derive, but other packages depend on openssl

findings.summary: rust-openssl has undefined behavior in X509Ref::ocsp_responders for certificates with non-UTF-8 OCSP URLs

evidence: the project's source does not use X509Ref::ocsp_responders, but other packages depend on openssl

findings.summary: Quinn: Remote memory exhaustion in quinn-proto from unbounded out-of-order stream reassembly
Quinn affected by unauthenticated remote DoS via panic in QUIC transport parameter parsing
Peer minimum ACK delay can panic quinn-proto when ACK_FREQUENCY transmission is enabled

evidence: the project's source does not use ACK_FREQUENCY, but other packages depend on quinn-proto

findings.summary: rustls-webpki: Denial of service via panic on malformed CRL BIT STRING
Insecure Preservation of SUID/SGID Bits during ZIP Extraction Leading to Potential Privilege Escalation
zip: `ZipArchive::extract` aborts the process on a symlink entry with a large declared size

evidence: the project's source does not use ZipArchive::extract, but other packages depend on zip

findings.summary: zip Incorrectly Canonicalizes Paths during Archive Extraction Leading to Arbitrary File Write
zip: Unbounded Symlink-Target Handling Can Abort Or Exhaust Memory During Extraction
ZipStreamReader::extract() and ZipArchive::extract() apply Unix permissions through symlinks without confining the target

evidence: no source file uses ZipStreamReader::extract, ZipArchive::extract; only the project depends on zip
